# Shiftora

> Shiftora is an integrated strategy and systems firm. It works where institutional direction and operating reality diverge, from governing judgment through the organization and systems required to carry it out.

Shiftora's work may take institutional, organizational, financial, operational, or technical form. Where new capability is required, Shiftora builds it. The governing standard is sovereign capacity: the institution remains free to alter course while retaining authority over the systems, data, models, and knowledge on which action depends.

## Pages

- [The firm](https://www.shiftora.ai/): The institutional thesis and the role Shiftora assumes.
- [Mandates](https://www.shiftora.ai/mandates): The institutional conditions that may give rise to a Shiftora mandate.
